title: Rendition
description: One downloadable form of an asset. original = uploaded bytes, unmodified; web = longest side <= 2000 px JPEG; square = web centred on a white square canvas; thumb = longest side <= 600 px JPEG.

url.description: Download URL. Either short-lived signed (usable without Authorization until url_expires_at; it MAY be on another host, such as object storage or a CDN) or requiring the Bearer token. Never a permanent public URL. Clients MUST treat it as opaque, MUST NOT keep it past url_expires_at and MUST NOT use it as a cache key: the URL changes with every signature, `sha256` does not (protocol.md §5.5.1).

url_expires_at.description: When a signed `url` stops working; null when the URL requires the Bearer token. At least 5 minutes after the response that carried it.

content_type.description: Media type. 'original' keeps the uploaded type; web/square/thumb are image/jpeg.

sha256.description: sha256 of the rendition's bytes: its cache key. Stays the same when the URL is signed again; changes exactly when the bytes change.
